notes:
Summary: ZeitFlow is building a trader-facing conversational assistant and lightning-fast reranking layer for market signals. Primary goal = keep inference cost predictable while delivering low tail latency for 1:1 chat and microsecond-sensitive rerank calls. Key asks: provide a validated perf benchmark for their workload shape + actionable Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quantization) that show token-cost reductions without regressions.

Details / CRM-style bullets:
- Workload mix: 70% short chat turns (avg 80 tokens), 20% reranking (10-30 tokens, tight p99 SLO), 10% embedding/upsert background jobs.
- Traffic profile: steady 120 req/s baseline, spikes to 800 req/s during market open; burst handling is critical.
- Latency targets: chat p50 < 60ms, p95 < 150ms, rerank p99 < 35ms for top-of-stack calls. Strong emphasis on p99s.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to cut token spend 30-50% vs current baseline via batching and 8-bit quantization; prefer recommendations with simulated unit economics.
- Model preferences: open-models (Llama-family and variants), likely to accept 8-bit/quantized variants if QA shows parity. Interested in Redwood-verified model performance profiles.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant under capacity pressure; must preserve any SLAs for premium trader flows.
- Security: SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS for keying, full audit logs and 7yr retention on critical audit events; EU data residency for EU users.
- Deployment: start hosted API for speed, then evaluate Dedicated pools in eu-west for predictable throughput; private (VPC) considered for production-regulated flows.
